tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos skyong stag zhon gyi gtor chog bzhugs so// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po'i sa gzhi/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du/ dpal ldan mgon po nag po stag zhon lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i sa bon dang / rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can dang / ri bo ma la ya la sogs pa'i gnas rnams nas bstan srung nag po chen po ye shes pa 'khor bcas sprin 'thibs par byon par gyur/ hūm̐ sngon tshe laṅka yul gyi grong khyer du/ /rdo rje gtum pos dam la btags pa yi/ /gying chen rdo rje sgrol byed drag po rtsal/ /mgon po nag po stag zhon gnas 'dir byon/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas shān+ti gar+bha dang / /ba su dha ra la sogs rgya bal gyi/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pas bka' bsgos gnyer gtad pa'i/ /rnal 'byor dgra lha nag po gnas 'dir byon/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa'i/ /bod yul sngags 'chang brgyud pas bsgrubs pa yi/ /stag zhog mgon po bka' yi bya ra ba/ /slob dpon brgyud pa'i srung ma gnas 'dir byon/ /khyad par drin can pha rgod bla ma yis/ /mngon sum zhal gzigs rnal 'byor sgos dgra'i gshed/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis mchod cing bsten pa'i lha/ /pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma gnas 'dir byon/ /khrag zhag rba klong 'khrug pa'i dur khrod 'dir/ /dam nyams baṃ chen sgyel ba'i khri steng du/ /dgra bgegs sha khrag dmar la rol ba dang / /rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir bzhugs su gsol/ /hūm̐/ lha mchog khyod la dam rdzas 'bul ba ni/ /ban+dha 'bar ba stong gsum khyon yangs pa/ /dam nyams sha rus ri ltar spungs pa dang / /gser skyems dmar chen rak+ta btung ba'i mtsho/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi ba liṃ ta/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas mchod pa'i tshogs/

/dngos bshams yid sprul mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ /bstan srung nag po stag bzhon 'khor bcas mchod/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi dgra lha nag po mchod/ /slob dpon brgyud kyi srung ma nag po mchod/ /yum chen dpal ldan 'dod khams gtso mo mchod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa rnam gsum mchod/ /srog gcod bdud kyi mon pa mched bdun mchod/ /lho byang gshin rje gnod sbyin tshogs rnams mchod/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro mchod/ /dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad gnyan po mchod/ /sprul pa yang sprul bcas pa'i tshogs rnams mchod/ /oṃ shrī mahā kā la tri yaṃ dzaḥdzaḥ dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ tra rak+sha ha la dgra bo mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ dun ru tra ru thum bha ti dzaḥ shud pa ra tsa trī shaṃ yaṃ dzaḥ badz+ra triṣ+ṇa pa dhu kha thum/ tri sa mā ra ya dzaḥ sa pā ri wā ra sarba bigh+naṃ sha truṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā t+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhuṣ+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ mahā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha hi/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ lcang lo can gyi dur khrod nas/ /dpal mgon nag po stag zhon bskyod/ /byang shar khrag mtsho'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug bskyod/ /mthing nag 'bar ba'i pho brang nas/ /bdud btsan gying gi mon pa bskyod/ /srog gcod shan pa'i grong khyer nas/ /bdud kyi mon pa mched bdun bskyod/ /lho byang nam mkha' sa gzhi nas/ /gshin rje gnod sbyin rngams pa bskyod/ /dur khrod khrag mtsho'i khor yug nas/ /nad bdag ma mo 'bum sde bskyod/ /bdud yul mkha' rag mgo dgu nas/ /bdud po ri nag spungs pa bskyod/ /rgya yul nam mkha' chad chod nas/ /rgyal po 'od lha dkar po bskyod/ /me rlung 'khrug pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /srog bdag lcags gzhu nag po bskyod/ /mang yul byang shar mtsho gting nas/ /ma mo rdo rje sder chen bskyod/ /phyogs bzhin nam mkha'i klong yangs nas/

/gza' bdud drag po mgo dgu bskyod/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po nas/ /btsan rje shu bo lag ring bskyod/ /shar lho rin chen thang dkyil nas/ /gying chen rdo rje legs pa bskyod/ /klu yul na ra sing sngon nas/ /klu gnyan nag po srog gcod bskyod/ /dgongs shig mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /gsang bdag rdo rje gtum po nas/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ /bsgrubs shing bsten pa'i dam tshig dgongs/ /sman raka sha khrag gtor ma longs/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ /dge 'dun sde 'di gces par skyongs/ /bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po/ /mi nor yul 'khor bcas pa rnams/ /bsrung zhing bskyab dang sba ba dang / /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/ /rbod gtong byad mar bcas pa kun/ /gtum chen khyod kyi drag shul gyis/ /da lta nyid du bsgral bar gyis/ /sha rus don snying nang khrol zo/ /snying khrag dron mo btung bar rol/ /mi lpags dmar po gos su gyon/ /rgyu rlon mgo 'phreng rgyan du thogs/ /las nyon sgrib pa kun sbyangs te/ /sems nyid dag pa'i zhing du spor/ /bdag gis bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'di/ /myur du sgrubs shig sa ma ya/ /zhes pha mes gnyan gyi srung ma stag zhon nag po'i mchod gtor mdor bsdus gyer sgom du bya ba'i tshul 'di ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal gyis las dang po pa rnams kyi nyams len du bkod pa'o// //dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho / chos skyong stag zhon gyi gtor chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
